## Goal

Retire the legacy `collab` namespace now that `shared-kb` is canonical and collab is frozen.

## State (open-brain DB, 2026-06-19)

- `thoughts`: collab = 11,943, of which **11,874 already mirrored to shared-kb** (content_hash match); **69 NOT yet in shared-kb**.
- `ob_entities`: 12 collab rows (repo_facts, created_by rico, 2026-06-18).
- `ob_session_lanes`: 4 collab lanes.
- No collab writes since 2026-06-18 18:15 — frozen.

## Work

- [ ] Migrate/promote the **69 un-mirrored collab thoughts** to shared-kb (or classify+archive if noise).
- [ ] Decide fate of the 12 collab `repo_fact` entities + 4 collab lanes (re-tag to shared-kb / rico / archive).
- [ ] Once collab has no live unique content, remove `collab` as `legacySharedNamespace` from config/code (read-policy fallback, shared-namespace.ts) and drop the legacy read-fallback paths.
- [ ] Coordinate with the stale-defaults fix (separate issue) so tooling no longer references collab.

## Non-goals
- No bulk delete of collab rows without confirming they're mirrored/archived first.

## Sequencing
After the memory-tiering pipeline (#159 → #160/#161). Lower priority; collab is frozen and 99.4% mirrored, so it's not actively harmful — just cleanup. Captured 2026-06-19.
